In-app support options also appear to be disabled or redirect to generic help content in English.

**User Report**:

> "I tried using the app during a trip to Mexico City, and it felt half-functional. Some parts of the UI were still in English, even though my phone is set to Spanish. I couldn’t find any available drivers for over 30 minutes, even near the airport. Also, I noticed that the help section didn’t show local contact info or Spanish-language support."
